title: Associate Product Manager Learning Roadmap
summary: A focused path to sharpen product discovery, specification, and delivery skills, then build a showcase portfolio. Finish with advanced tactics and job‑ready preparation.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Solidify core product thinking and communication basics.

milestones.title: Customer Discovery Basics
milestones.outcome: Can conduct structured user interviews and synthesize insights.

tasks.title: Read product discovery guide
tasks.description: Study the “Product Discovery” section on the Mind the Product blog.

tasks.title: Watch interview techniques video
tasks.description: View the free video on user interview best practices on YouTube.

tasks.title: Create interview script
tasks.description: Draft a 5‑question script for a target user segment using a template from Product School.

tasks.title: Conduct mock interview
tasks.description: Pair with a peer and run the script, recording notes.

tasks.title: Summarize findings
tasks.description: Write a one‑page insight summary and share with a mentor for feedback.

milestones.title: Writing Effective Specs
milestones.outcome: Can produce clear, concise product requirement documents.

tasks.title: Read PRD template
tasks.description: Review the free PRD template on Aha! blog and note key sections.

tasks.title: Study spec style guide
tasks.description: Read the “Writing Clear Specs” article on Intercom’s product docs.

tasks.title: Draft a spec outline
tasks.description: Create an outline for a simple feature (e.g., “bookmark button”) using the template.

tasks.title: Write full spec draft
tasks.description: Fill in the outline with user problem, solution, acceptance criteria, and UI mock‑ups.

tasks.title: Get feedback loop
tasks.description: Send draft to a colleague and incorporate their comments.

milestones.title: Prioritisation Foundations
milestones.outcome: Can apply a structured framework to rank feature ideas.

tasks.title: Read prioritisation frameworks
tasks.description: Study the RICE and MoSCoW articles on the ProductPlan blog.

tasks.title: Watch prioritisation webinar
tasks.description: View the free webinar on prioritisation at Product School.

tasks.title: Score sample ideas
tasks.description: Take a list of 5 hypothetical features and assign RICE scores in a spreadsheet.

tasks.title: Create prioritisation cheat sheet
tasks.description: Summarize the steps and formulas on a one‑page reference sheet.

tasks.title: Reflect on trade‑offs
tasks.description: Write a short note on why the top‑ranked idea wins over others.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Deepen analytical, roadmap, and stakeholder abilities.

milestones.title: Metrics and Analytics Basics
milestones.outcome: Can define success metrics and set up simple dashboards.

tasks.title: Read analytics fundamentals
tasks.description: Read the “Analytics for Product Managers” guide on Mixpanel’s blog.

tasks.title: Explore Google Analytics demo
tasks.description: Navigate the free GA demo account and locate key reports.

tasks.title: Define KPI for a feature
tasks.description: Choose a measurable KPI (e.g., conversion rate) for the bookmark feature and write a brief rationale.

tasks.title: Build a mock dashboard
tasks.description: Use Google Data Studio’s free template to create a simple dashboard displaying the KPI.

tasks.title: Share dashboard for critique
tasks.description: Post the dashboard in a product community forum and gather feedback.

milestones.title: Roadmapping Techniques
milestones.outcome: Can construct a visual product roadmap aligned with strategy.

tasks.title: Read roadmapping article
tasks.description: Study the “How to Build a Product Roadmap” article on Aha! blog.

tasks.title: Watch roadmap tools tour
tasks.description: View the free tour of Trello and Miro roadmapping boards on YouTube.

tasks.title: Sketch quarterly roadmap
tasks.description: Using Miro’s free board, plot a 4‑quarter roadmap for the bookmark feature series.

tasks.title: Create roadmap slide deck
tasks.description: Export the Miro board to PDF and add brief narrative slides in Google Slides.

tasks.title: Get stakeholder input
tasks.description: Present the deck to a peer acting as a stakeholder and note suggestions.

milestones.title: Stakeholder Communication
milestones.outcome: Can convey product decisions clearly to cross‑functional teams.

tasks.title: Read communication guide
tasks.description: Read the “Effective Stakeholder Communication” article on Product Coalition.

tasks.title: Watch storytelling for PMs video
tasks.description: Watch the free video on storytelling in product meetings from Product School.

tasks.title: Draft stakeholder email
tasks.description: Write an email announcing the roadmap and rationale for the bookmark feature.

tasks.title: Record a presentation
tasks.description: Create a 5‑minute recorded pitch of the feature using Loom.

tasks.title: Seek feedback on tone
tasks.description: Share the email and video with a mentor and adjust based on feedback.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Apply learned skills to tangible portfolio pieces.

milestones.title: Product Teardown
milestones.outcome: Showcase ability to critique an existing product’s strengths and gaps.

tasks.title: Select product to teardown
tasks.description: Choose a popular consumer app and note its core value proposition.

tasks.title: Analyze user flow
tasks.description: Map the main user journey using a free diagram tool like draw.io.

tasks.title: Identify pain points
tasks.description: Write a list of three usability issues backed by screenshots.

tasks.title: Write teardown report
tasks.description: Compose a 2‑page report with findings, metrics, and improvement suggestions.

tasks.title: Publish on portfolio site
tasks.description: Upload the report to a personal website or Notion page and share the link.

milestones.title: Feature PRD Project
milestones.outcome: Demonstrates end‑to‑end specification skills for a realistic feature.

tasks.title: Define feature scope
tasks.description: Choose a concrete feature (e.g., “in‑app search”) and outline its boundaries.

tasks.title: Conduct quick user survey
tasks.description: Create a 3‑question survey on Google Forms and collect 10 responses.

tasks.title: Write full PRD
tasks.description: Produce a complete product requirement document using the Aha! template.

tasks.title: Add acceptance criteria
tasks.description: List clear, testable acceptance criteria for each user story.

tasks.title: Share PRD for review
tasks.description: Post the PRD in a product community for peer review and note comments.

milestones.title: Metrics Plan for Launch
milestones.outcome: Illustrates capability to design measurement frameworks for product releases.

tasks.title: Select launch scenario
tasks.description: Pick a recent feature launch (e.g., “dark mode”) to model metrics.

tasks.title: Identify success metrics
tasks.description: Define 3 leading and 2 lagging metrics aligned with business goals.

tasks.title: Design measurement plan
tasks.description: Create a one‑page plan outlining data sources, collection methods, and reporting cadence.

tasks.title: Build mock dashboard
tasks.description: Use Google Data Studio free template to visualize the metrics.

tasks.title: Present plan to mentor
tasks.description: Give a 5‑minute walkthrough to a senior PM and capture feedback.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Advance to senior concepts and prepare for job or freelance opportunities.

milestones.title: Advanced Prioritisation & Trade‑offs
milestones.outcome: Can lead prioritisation workshops and justify decisions with data.

tasks.title: Read advanced prioritisation case study
tasks.description: Study the “Scaling Prioritisation at Airbnb” case on Medium.

tasks.title: Facilitate mock workshop
tasks.description: Run a 30‑minute prioritisation session with peers using RICE on a real backlog.

tasks.title: Create decision matrix
tasks.description: Build a spreadsheet matrix that scores features against strategic themes.

tasks.title: Document workshop outcomes
tasks.description: Write a concise summary of decisions and rationales.

tasks.title: Network with PM community
tasks.description: Attend a free virtual product meetup and share your workshop experience.

milestones.title: Strategic Roadmapping & Vision
milestones.outcome: Can craft multi‑year product visions and translate them into actionable roadmaps.

tasks.title: Read vision‑setting article
tasks.description: Read the “Product Vision vs. Strategy” article on ProductPlan blog.

tasks.title: Write a product vision statement
tasks.description: Draft a 2‑sentence vision for a hypothetical SaaS tool.

tasks.title: Map 2‑year roadmap
tasks.description: Use a free Miro template to plot quarterly themes and key initiatives.

tasks.title: Align roadmap with metrics
tasks.description: Link each initiative to at least one KPI from earlier phases.

tasks.title: Share roadmap on LinkedIn
tasks.description: Post the visual roadmap with a brief explanation to showcase expertise.

milestones.title: Job‑Ready Portfolio & Interview Prep
milestones.outcome: Possesses a polished portfolio and can articulate product decisions in interviews.

tasks.title: Create portfolio website
tasks.description: Set up a free GitHub Pages site and add the three portfolio projects.

tasks.title: Write case‑study narratives
tasks.description: For each project, write a 300‑word story highlighting problem, process, and impact.

tasks.title: Practice STAR interview answers
tasks.description: Draft STAR responses for common PM questions focusing on discovery and metrics.

tasks.title: Mock interview with peer
tasks.description: Conduct a 30‑minute product interview simulation and receive feedback.

tasks.title: Connect with recruiters
tasks.description: Reach out to 5 product recruiter contacts on LinkedIn with a brief intro and portfolio link.
